admission.justification: Future changes to task-page reads, conditional transport, native generation capture or retained-content ownership must prevent stale or unbounded cache reuse and a counter failure blocking the document. Named current source assertions guard the specified facets; historical timing/count samples remain task-local, not enduring obligations or fresh Curator grades.

applicability: Task-document presentation independently of committed/working/master change-set counter completion.
conditions: The available summary/document remains rendered while the downstream counter request is pending or fails.
Counter controls retain their own loading, unrecorded, unmeasured, measured-empty and refusal states without gating the document reader.
An abandoned counter read is not a failure: a task switch ends the bar's own counter request and the document remains visible without an error for it.
exclusions: This is not a guarantee that missing or failed document-body reads become available, nor an acceptance of failed change-set reads.

evidence: sync-L81-dashboard.txt; document-first/failure cases in full dashboard suite

statement: The document remains visible while change-set requests are pending or fail.
